content:
Grouping from the datasheet: two OIF 400ZR application codes (amplified 0x01 vs unamplified 0x02); shared 400 Gbps, ITU C-Band, 100 GHz grid (6.25 GHz tune steps), 16QAM line-side; -20.0 dBm RX only for unamplified (footnote 1); -12.0 dBm for amplified (footnotes 2–3). No separate evidence for 100 Gbps / 4 lanes / PAM-4 as distinct operating modes.
